mapper.update: update notification_unread_stats set unread_count = unread_count + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{receiverUserId}
mapper.insert: insert into notification_unread_stats (user_id, unread_count) select #{receiverUserId}, 1 where not exists ( select 1 from notification_unread_stats where user_id = #{receiverUserId} )
mapper.select: select id from user_device_tokens where user_id = #{receiverUserId} and enabled = true
